title: Nordic Spiced Norwegian Halibut Gratin
description: A rich and dense Norwegian dish featuring cloves, served with a low-calorie-friendly brine-wet sauce.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) with the rack in the lower third position.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and dust with flour.
Place halibut fillets on the prepared baking sheet, leaving space between each fillet.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, butter, onion, cloves, thyme, salt, and pepper to form a paste.
Spread the paste evenly over each halibut fillet, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Bake for 8 minutes or until the edges are lightly browned and the fish is cooked to your liking.
While the fish is baking, whisk together brine liquid and milk in a small saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat and cook for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened.
Remove the fish from the oven and carefully place it on top of a baking dish.
Pour the brine sauce over the fish and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes or until heated through.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately.
